about: Non-dialogue text: objectives, help boxes, failure reasons, HUD and console labels. Keys are GXT keys (max 7 characters). ~1~ is replaced by a number at runtime; ~k~~ACTION~ shows the player's bound key; ~n~ is a new line. Keep text plain ASCII.

text.V3O07: Drive to the flagged van in ~y~Easter Basin~s~.
text.V3O08: Follow the ~r~delivery van~s~. Keep your distance.
text.V3O09: Park near the ~r~delivery van~s~ to finish the readings.
text.V3O11: Stop the van on each ~y~measurement point~s~ and hold still.
text.V3O13: Escort the ~b~minivan~s~. Stay close while R.A.I.N. uploads.
text.V3H01: Equip the camera and press ~k~~PED_FIREWEAPON~ while standing in a ~y~marker~s~ facing the group.
text.V3H03: The evidence meter fills while you stay 15-60 m behind the van. Don't hit it.
text.V3H04: Stop inside the marker and hold still to take a reading.
text.V3H05: Stay within 40 m of the minivan so R.A.I.N. can upload the evidence.
text.V3H07: Christopher's custom model was not found, so a stand-in pedestrian is used. See the mod README to install it.
text.V3F04: ~r~You hit the delivery van. The evidence is contaminated.
text.V3F09: ~r~Max Certainty was hurt. The demonstration is over.
text.V3P08: Making intelligent systems more trustworthy, one verified decision at a time.
text.V3P09: NO GATE. NO CREDENTIAL. NO PERMISSION.
text.V3N03: CERTAIN PILOT SUSPENDED PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW
text.V3T03: Resonance as Substrate. Intelligence as a Layer.
text.V3T05: SENSOR A ~1~.~1~ uT        SENSOR B ~1~ Hz
text.V3T08: WARNING: 37 OF 41 CLAIMS EXCEED THEIR EVIDENCE
text.V3L01: ~y~99.9% SURE~s~ - a Vers3Dynamics mission. Walk into the marker to start.
text.V3L02: Press ~k~~CONVERSATION_YES~ to retry from the last checkpoint.
text.V3L04: Lose your wanted level before starting ~y~99.9% SURE~s~.

text.V3L06: ~y~99.9% SURE~s~ is complete. Walk into the marker to play it again.
